scope: Exact frozen pre-fit HHI information design; no fit, bootstrap, or account authorized by this review

duplicate_design.overlap: HHI and 1-minus-top5 are alternative concentration summaries of the same previously disclosed SOXX equity basket, with the same source maps, Stage1 H5 label, 3014/940 mature cohorts, Ridge receiver, and reused held history.
duplicate_design.control_difference: This HHI design compares original 39 inputs against 39 plus HHI. The canonical diversity design includes source age, NPORT form, and expected 2021 index-era controls in both arms. Its incremental result would therefore answer a different conditional question; the two screens cannot be treated as independent confirmations of one mechanism.
duplicate_design.family_conflict: Both frozen plans allocate one-sided alpha 0.025/27 while each reserves two fits and one bootstrap. Running both would add a second same-mechanism candidate without a frozen mutual exclusion or corrected joint family budget.

minimum_action: Close this HHI version before fit and retain its no-fit preflight receipt. Proceed, if separately approved, with the already frozen reported-diversity card as the single canonical information screen. Do not use later HHI or top-five outcomes to choose between the two.
scientific_boundary: The source timing and label preflight do not establish predictive value, fee-net SOXX excess, or independent forward evidence.
